root_cause.manual_switch: The deployed 0.2.6 router could retain a pre-semantic request lease after active semantic streams reached zero, leaving only one usable account and rejecting a safe manual route change with HTTP 409.
root_cause.quota_display: The panel collapsed an absent Weekly observation to Unavailable and rendered cooldown timestamps as one long primary value, so missing data and wrapped data were indistinguishable.

implementation.weekly_observed_format: <percent>% remaining plus a separate UTC observation line
implementation.cooldown_active_format: Active plus bounded remaining time and a separate UTC deadline line
implementation.cooldown_elapsed_format: Elapsed plus a separate UTC end line

failure_first.failure: Expected 75% remaining but the predecessor returned 75%.

bounded_rollback_attempts: The first attempt rejected cross-platform gzip byte drift before activation.
Two readiness attempts rejected an incomplete trusted browser-session probe.
One diagnostic activation proved all three 8216 units and two usable accounts, then rolled back because the public request lacked a trusted browser session.

manual_switch.path: trusted 8216 browser session, same-origin CSRF-protected router switch endpoint

browser_observation.reason: The browser-control channel timed out while optional Statsig requests to ab.chatgpt.com were also timing out. Installed asset hashes, local panel-model tests and the exact browser-session switch route were verified independently.

security_audit.reason: The aggregate audit correctly failed closed because protected routed UI paths changed after the retained remote strict-CI baseline.

residual_risks: Weekly quota is observation-driven. After the router upgrade neither account had emitted a fresh Weekly observation, so the truthful live label is Not observed yet until a later provider usage event is received.

The manual roundtrip proves safe route-preference persistence and browser-bridge behavior only. Because no model request was sent, it does not re-prove that either private credential is currently accepted by the provider.
Direct automated visual extraction did not complete because the browser-control channel timed out; no visual layout claim beyond the tested model, CSS contract and installed asset hashes is made.
A new strict remote CI qualification is still required for the changed protected UI paths.
Every accepted switch starts a new backend session; no failed request, prior session, in-flight work or running computation is resumed.
